title: MOXI, The Wolf Museum of Exploration + Innovation

services.name: General Admission
services.desc: Educators within Santa Barbara or Ventura Counties (grades K-12) receive free admission when presenting current, valid identification from their employer at time of purchase. This offer may only be redeemed onsite at MOXI, admission subject to capacity

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Spark your students’ curiosity and ignite learning. MOXI welcomes school groups from throughout Santa Barbara and Ventura Counties and beyond! Field Trips are available for grades Pre-K through 12 and include access to all three floors of the museum. Engineering Explorations programs are available to add on to your field trips! MOXI’s playful exhibits focus on physical science, engineering design, and technology and align with Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS). During a field trip visit, students creatively engage in the practices of scientists and engineers as they make observations, ask questions, carry out investigations, construct explanations, define problems, and design

services.name: By Bike
services.desc: We encourage our guests to find alternative, “car-free” ways to visit MOXI. Bicycling to MOXI may be a particularly good option for local guests. Bike racks are available at the front and rear of our building for our guests that choose to bike to MOXI. More information on bike routes and getting around Santa Barbara
